title: 第83章 魔鼠清剿第82章 平稳推进
content_zh:
石家军能够只凭着皇族势力的军团实力，在各支军团的任务积分排名中，进入前一百名，甚至一度冲进前十，确实是令人刮目相看。
“小军突破成功了？”
“刚收到消息，已经在天龙城的洞天秘境中完成结婴，晋升五阶。”
“那就好，让他赶紧归队，这两个月他不在，我们的积分排名已经掉到了九十一名了。”
石家军在冷辉大陆上的搜索任务进展，这两个月都有些不顺利，好几次都扑空了，被魔族的特殊法术误导了几次，被耍得团团转，没有一点积分进账，急得他们有些坐不住了。
因为军团积分排名如果掉出一百名，季度结算的时候，就没有更高的积分加成，他们在前线拼命打的那些积分，要掉好几万的。
天龙城是新收复的超级大陆刚建设的主城，规模宏大，并且处于顶级灵脉附近，灵气非常充沛，在顶级灵脉上有数座超级洞天秘境，里面的灵气更加浓郁得化雾成云，甚至是结晶。
石小军临近突破关口，所以石家就花费了不少积分，让他进入天龙城的洞天秘境修炼，冲击第五阶。
两个月下来，终于等来好消息，石小军以最好的状态，成功结婴，即日将归队。
五天后，转乘三次传送阵，又搭乘快速穿梭飞船，石小军终于回到了冷辉大陆的前线营地。
晋升五阶之后，
石小军的元神凝聚，可以离体遨游虚空，但此时还很小，在外面受到伤害无法自保，就像婴儿一样弱小。
它最大的意义，还是让他的神识终于实现跨越式的提升。
“小军，你现在状态如何？”
“九叔，我感觉比之前有百倍提升，恨不得马上开战试试身手。”
石乐志满意的点点头，“那大地支柱的感应范围，提升到多少里了？”
“差不多是五十里，但我开发了几种新的用法，减少感应区域，单线向前延伸，最高可以达到五百公里……”
也就是千里之内，都能感应得到，不过单线扫描式感应，比全域范围内的全面感应，显然是差不少，一些细节肯定要漏失的。
但这没有关系，现在他们只需要探查到目标的存在，至于它们的数量多少，实力如何，不需要太详细，只要定位到它们的存在就完事了。
两个月没有开张，石乐志他们现在是等不急了，小军一归队，他们马上开工，集结军团准备开战。

石小军拿出大地支柱棍子，它已经蜕变过四次，还差一次就能晋升到灵品了。
凡器也是有品质划分的，有些只需要三次蜕变就能晋升灵器，但有些却要九次蜕变。
而他这根棍子，算是中上品质的，只要五次蜕变就化灵。
此时它的灵性已经很高，属于半灵品的品质，材质从之前的灰不溜秋，到现在已经具有一些金玉光泽，隐约有一丝灵光从棍身里面透射出来，那一条条纹理，半掩半现的，此时也变得十分清晰，有一些在发出微光。
它的长度也从两尺，提升到四尺半，一米多，差不多到胸口的位置了。
握在手中也更加充实，不像之前那么细小，握起来好像没握住什么东西一样。
但它的重量也非常的惊人，如果是普通人来拿，恐怕用尽全身力量都拿不动，即使是炼体高手，三阶力量的强度，都难以挥动它。
石小军晋升五阶之后，神识感应这根棍子，更加有一种血脉相连的感觉，好像是自己身体里的一部分，用御棍法控制它的时候，不需要用手接触，它自己就会挥舞起来，因为它的重量惊人，每一击都蕴含了强大的破坏力。
当然这只是相对于中低阶的目标而言的，在高手眼中，这些都只是小打小闹。
恰好现在他们要对付的魔军小队，大部分都是中阶和低阶的实力。
石家军很快集结完毕，就在营地前的空地上，集结了有三百人的队伍，并不是整支军团，并且像石乐志这样的军团统领，是并不参加这些小规模的追杀的。
带队的只是一名七阶的长老，叫石乐水。
“十八叔，我们出发吧。”石小军手握着棍子，走到石乐水的身边。
石乐水点点头，招手点将，制止了军团中各成员的私聊，“都灵醒一点，这次我们一定要把附近八千里范围的地下魔鼠都翻找出来，战斗场次会不少，你们都别大意。”
石小军启动大地领域，营地空地就像水一样，快速软化，所有成员快速沉入地下，随着他们消失在地面上，整片营地又恢复了如常。
石乐志等军团高层将领看着他们消失，都纷纷松一口气，“这次，我们要快速追赶排名，还剩下十二天就到了季度积分结算了。”
“有小军，没问题的，我们一天起码可以打三场，轮换着出手的话，我们五天就能冲进前五十名了，这个季度有望重回前十呢。”
“别自大，我们虽然在冲分，别人也没有停滞不前，那些大族势力，他们也是有自己的追踪手段的，虽然不如小军，但也不会差到哪里去。”
小军带着团队沉入到地下，开辟一个五十米范围的小空间，容纳所有军团成员，然后向着一个方向快速的移动。
就像潜水器一样，他们在地下就如同在水里，不受任何的泥地阻碍影响，就连石头都无法拦阻他们的前进。所有前方遇到的石头泥沙，都纷纷让开一条通道，让他们快速通过。

“找到目标没有？”石乐水在小军的旁边，神情有些凝重，在地下他真的有些紧张，因为这不同于地面上的战斗，地下空间太小了，要依靠小军开辟更大的空间来进行战斗，如果小军支撑不住，他们的战斗也会受到影响。
之前的好几次，小军都出现有力不从心的迹象，因为四阶的实力，还是有些勉强，但现在他已经五阶，跟之前相比完全是两个层次。
content_en:
The Shi Family Army was able to enter the top 100 in each legion's mission points rankings, and even broke into the top ten at one time, relying solely on the legion strength of the royal family. It is indeed impressive.
"Did Xiaojun break through successfully?"
"I just received the news that the birth of a baby has been completed in the Cave Heaven Secret Realm of Tianlong City and promoted to the fifth level."
"That's good, let him return to the team as soon as possible. Since he has been away for the past two months, our ranking has dropped to 91st."
The progress of Shi Jiajun's search mission on Lenghui Continent has been somewhat unsatisfactory in the past two months. They failed several times, were misled several times by the special spells of the demons, were fooled around, and did not gain any points. They were so anxious that they could not sit still.
Because if the legion's points ranking drops out of 100, there will be no higher point bonus at the quarterly settlement. Those points they fought hard on the front line will lose tens of thousands.
Tianlong City is the newly built main city of the newly recovered supercontinent. It is large in scale and is located near the top spiritual veins. The spiritual energy is very abundant. There are several super caves and secret realms on the top spiritual veins. The spiritual energy inside is so rich that it turns into clouds and even crystallizes.
Shi Xiaojun was approaching the breakthrough point, so the Shi family spent a lot of points to let him enter the Cave Heaven Secret Realm of Tianlong City to practice and hit the fifth level.
After two months, the good news finally came. Shi Xiaojun was in the best condition, successfully gave birth to a baby, and will return to the team soon.
Five days later, after three transfers to the teleportation array and a fast shuttle ship, Shi Xiaojun finally returned to the frontline camp in Lenghui Continent.
After being promoted to the fifth level,
Shi Xiaojun's soul is condensed and can leave the body and travel in the void, but he is still very young at this time and cannot protect himself if he is hurt outside. He is as weak as a baby.
Its greatest significance was that his consciousness finally achieved a leap-forward improvement.
"Xiaojun, how are you doing now?"
"Uncle Ninth, I feel a hundred times better than before. I can't wait to start a battle right away to try my skills."
Shi Lezhi nodded with satisfaction, "How many miles has the sensing range of the Earth Pillar been increased to?"
"Almost fifty miles, but I have developed several new uses to reduce the sensing area and extend the single line forward, which can reach up to five hundred kilometers..."
That is to say, it can be sensed within thousands of miles, but the single-line scanning sensing is obviously much worse than the comprehensive sensing in the whole area, and some details will definitely be missed.
But it doesn't matter. Now they only need to detect the existence of the target. As for their number and strength, they don't need to be too detailed. As long as they locate their existence, they will be done.
After not opening for two months, Shi Lezhi and the others couldn't wait any longer. As soon as the small army returned, they immediately started work and assembled the army to prepare for war.
Shi Xiaojun took out the Earth Pillar Stick. It had already transformed four times and was still one time away from being promoted to the spiritual level.
Mortal weapons are also classified by quality. Some only need three transformations to be promoted to spiritual weapons, but some require nine transformations.
As for his stick, it is considered to be of medium to high quality. It only takes five transformations to transform into a spirit.
At this time, its spirituality is already very high, and it is of semi-spiritual quality. The material has changed from being gray before, to now it has some golden and jade luster. There is a faint trace of spiritual light transmitting from the inside of the stick. The stripes of texture, half hidden and half visible, have become very clear at this time, and some are glowing slightly.
Its length also increased from two feet to four and a half feet, more than one meter, almost reaching the chest level.
It is also more substantial in the hand, not as small as before, and it feels like it is not holding anything.
But its weight is also very astonishing. If an ordinary person were to pick it up, they would probably not be able to lift it with all their strength. Even a master of body training with the strength of the third level of strength would have difficulty swinging it.
After Shi Xiaojun was promoted to the fifth level, his spiritual consciousness sensed the stick, and he felt even more connected by blood, as if he was his own.It is a part of one's body. When you control it with the stick method, it will swing by itself without touching it with your hands. Because of its amazing weight, every blow contains powerful destructive power.
Of course, this is only relative to the middle and low-level goals. In the eyes of experts, these are just trivial matters.
It just so happened that most of the demon army squads they had to deal with were of mid-level and low-level strength.
The Shi Family Army quickly assembled, and a team of 300 people was assembled in the open space in front of the camp. It was not the entire legion, and legion commanders like Shi Lezhi did not participate in these small-scale pursuits.
The team was led by a seventh-level elder named Shi Leshui.
"Uncle Eighteen, let's go." Shi Xiaojun held a stick in his hand and walked to Shi Leshui's side.
Shi Leshui nodded, waved to the general, and stopped the private chat among the members of the legion. "Turing, wake up. This time we must dig out all the underground demon rats within a radius of 8,000 miles. There will be a lot of battles, so don't be careless."
Shi Xiaojun activated the earth realm, and the open space in the camp softened quickly like water. All members quickly sank into the ground. As they disappeared on the ground, the entire camp returned to normal.
Seeing them disappear, Shi Lezhi and other high-ranking generals of the legion breathed a sigh of relief, "This time, we have to quickly catch up with the rankings. There are only twelve days left until the quarterly points are settled."
"With a small army, it's no problem. We can play at least three games a day. If we rotate our moves, we can break into the top 50 in five days. We are expected to return to the top ten this quarter."
"Don't be arrogant. Although we are rushing to score points, others have not stagnated. Those big clan forces also have their own tracking methods. Although they are not as good as the small army, they are not far behind."
Xiaojun and his team sank underground, opened up a small space of fifty meters to accommodate all the legion members, and then moved quickly in one direction.
Just like a submersible, they are underground as if they are in water, unaffected by any mud obstacles, and not even stones can stop their progress. All the stones and sand encountered in front of them gave way to a passage to allow them to pass quickly.
"Have you found the target?" Shi Leshui looked a little solemn next to Xiaojun. He was really nervous underground, because this was different from fighting on the ground. The underground space was too small, so Xiaojun had to open up a larger space to fight. If Xiaojun couldn't hold on, their battle would also be affected.
Several times before, Xiaojun showed signs of being incompetent. Because of his fourth-level strength, he was still a little reluctant, but now he is at fifth-level, which is a completely different level than before.
